Hahn Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Genpact Ltd. (G) by 10.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 931,022 shares of the professional services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $29.78B, down from 1.04 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hahn Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Genpact Ltd. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.78B market cap company. The stock increased 1.03% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $30.34. About 266,194 shares traded. Genpact Limited (NYSE:G) has risen 11.38% since June 1, 2017 and is uptrending.
